messages.author: 8c4f70ab584cd6d9
messages.subject: Setting rstan optimization level post-install
parts:
I recently upgraded my version of rstan from 2.6 to 2.8. After finishing the installation, I realized I had forgotten to set CXXFLAGS=-O3 before installing the new version. So I created the Makevars file post-installation.

Is this sufficient? Or do I need to un-install rstan or any of the dependencies?

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Setting rstan optimization level post-install
parts:
On Monday, November 9, 2015 at 12:39:53 PM UTC-5, John Hall wrote:
I recently upgraded my version of rstan from 2.6 to 2.8. After finishing the installation, I realized I had forgotten to set CXXFLAGS=-O3 before installing the new version. So I created the Makevars file post-installation.

Is this sufficient? Or do I need to un-install rstan or any of the dependencies?

It's fine. Having the optimization set to a particular level when you install rstan only affects the compilation of the Stan parser, which takes a negligible amount of time anyway. The models are compiled with whatever the level of optimization is when you call stan_model (perhaps indirectly via stan).

Ben
